response:
The cause is that `Close()` always closes the encoder, which writes the empty-stream trailer even when no body was written. The fix tracks whether any body bytes reached the encoder and skips `Close()` on the encoder when none did. The encoder is still reset and returned to its pool. I haven't run the test suite.
